The '''''Starrunner''-class starship''' was a model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] from [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]]. It was 31 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.

The ''[[Sand Sloth]]'' was one of this class. Though not on the market as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] employee [[Akeeli Somerce]] owned such a ship.
